# SVG in component vdom renders in the HTML namespace: ns never reaches the VNode

## Context

- **Real-browser witness** on `dev` @ `e77582cf74`, `useDomApiRenderer: true` (the default, `src/DefaultConfig.mjs:307`): in `examples/component/timer/`, the `<svg>` is an `HTMLUnknownElement` whose `namespaceURI` is `http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml`. Both `<circle>` children are `HTMLUnknownElement`s too, so the timer's ring never draws. Only its label and play button render.
- **Second occurrence:** a downstream package had to render its SVG overlay through `vdom.html` to get native `SVGSVGElement` and `SVGPathElement` nodes.
- **Live latest-open + closed sweep:** checked the latest open issues (8 open, green band) plus closed searches (`svg namespace`, `createElementNS`, `svg HTMLUnknownElement`, `Timer svg`) at 2026-11-09T09:40Z. Only #6785 (closed, VNode-to-DOM mapping) matched, and it is unrelated. No A2A claim on this surface; nothing in Memory Core.
- **Scope:** v13.4. The operator: tickets filed before the release get in.

## The Problem

`Neo.main.render.DomApiRenderer#createDomTree` called `document.createElementNS` only when `vnode.ns` was set (`src/main/render/DomApiRenderer.mjs:54-58`), and nothing ever set it: `Neo.vdom.VNode` copies no `ns` (`src/vdom/VNode.mjs:94-101`), and `Neo.vdom.Helper#createVnode` has no `ns` case. So with the DOM API renderer, every element was created with `document.createElement`, in the HTML namespace. That covers the initial mount, `insertNode`/`insertNodeBatch` deltas (`src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs`), and `changeNodeName` (`DeltaUpdates.mjs:158`). The string renderer is unaffected, because the HTML parser switches namespaces for `<svg>` markup on its own.

## The Architectural Reality

- The namespace is a property of an element's position in the DOM: `svg` and `math` open their namespace for their subtree, and SVG's `foreignObject` returns its children to HTML.
- The VDom worker sees one component's vdom at a time. A component whose root is a `<g>` cannot know that another component's `<svg>` will hold it.
- The main thread does know: `insertNode` and `insertNodeBatch` resolve the live `parentNode` before `createDomTree` builds the detached subtree.

**Prescription checked:** `src/vdom/Helper.mjs`; the better owner is `src/main/render/DomApiRenderer.mjs`. The VNode needs no namespace; the insertion parent decides it.

## The Fix

1. `DomApiRenderer.createDomTree` takes the inherited `namespace`. An element is created in `svg`/`math`'s namespace when it opens one, else in the inherited namespace (`createElementNS`), else as HTML (`createElement`, unchanged). Children inherit through `getChildNamespace(domNode)`, and fragments pass theirs through. The dead `vnode.ns` branch goes.
2. `DomApiRenderer.getChildNamespace(element)` returns the namespace an element's children are created in: its own for SVG/MathML, `null` for HTML and for `foreignObject`.
3. `DeltaUpdates.insertNode` and `insertNodeBatch` seed `createDomTree` with `getChildNamespace(parentNode)`.
4. `DeltaUpdates.changeNodeName` creates the replacement in the original's namespace.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: with the DOM API renderer, an `svg` subtree is created as SVG elements and draws. This holds when mounted under HTML, inserted into a live `<svg>` (singly and batched), and passed through a fragment. `foreignObject` is SVG while its children are HTML; `math` subtrees are MathML; a renamed SVG element stays SVG; HTML stays HTML. A component spec covers it, red-first on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-2: the Timer example's `<svg>` and `<circle>`s report `namespaceURI === 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'` and the ring draws, witnessed in a real browser.
- [ ] AC-3: string-renderer output is unchanged, and the unit and component suites stay green.

## Out of Scope

- Changing the default renderer.
- Namespaced attributes (`xlink:href`): SVG 2's plain `href` covers current use.

## Avoided Traps

- **Inferring the namespace in the VDom worker** (this ticket's first prescription): it cannot see across component boundaries, and it adds a VNode wire field the main thread can derive.
- **`createElementNS` for HTML too:** unlike `createElement`, it does not lowercase the tag name, so `DIV` would become an `HTMLUnknownElement`. HTML keeps `createElement`.

## Related

- Found while reviewing a downstream SVG overlay that works around this with unescaped `vdom.html`. That workaround should retire once this lands.
